sources.title: International first-year requirements
sources.cycle: Current undated policy; recheck for Fall 2028

requirements.text: International first-year applicants need the university-assessed equivalent of a 3.0/4.0 GPA. SAT 1200+ or ACT 25+ can satisfy this GPA requirement under the current policy; this does not waive other admission requirements.

coursework.text: General preparation: 4 years English/native language, 3 math, 3 science (2 laboratory), 2 social studies. The 2026–27 catalog adds a third social studies year and 2 years of one foreign language for Liberal Arts and Sciences. Ask Admissions to evaluate Ontario courses.

canadian.text: Submit original Ontario school records. The current country-equivalency file linked by Admissions could not be inspected; no Ontario percentage threshold is verified here. Do not convert your marks to a U.S. GPA yourself.

testing.text: SAT/ACT optional for applicants educated outside the U.S. Score submission may support placement and scholarship review. Fall 2028-specific testing policy: Not yet published in reviewed sources.

satRange.text: An official middle-50% SAT range was not verified in this review. No numerical competitive target is inferred from an unverified distribution.

acceptance.text: Official overall acceptance rate not verified in this review. No Ontario-specific admit rate is available in the reviewed sources.

english.text: An exemption covers native English speakers residing where English is a primary official language; Ontario attendance alone is not this exemption. IELTS 6.0 (each 5.5+); DET 105; TOEFL 71 (Speaking/Writing 17+) on the old scale or 4.0 (minimum band 3.5) from Jan 21, 2026. Other qualifying exams are listed officially.

application.text: University online portal; $65 USD international application fee. Upload official school records, English evidence if needed, financial statement/bank documentation and passport. Essays and recommendation letters are not required for admission. Final official records remain necessary after admission.

deadlines.text: Rolling review. Applications may be submitted up to a year before entry; university recommends allowing at least 6–8 weeks. Fall 2028 entry deadlines: Not yet published in reviewed sources. Current international merit scholarship reference: Feb 15 priority, May 1 final; not confirmed for 2028.

structure.text: University admission with additional college/curriculum requirements. Explore Sociology, Communication Studies and Political Science in Liberal Arts and Sciences. No verified evidence that selecting one raises admission odds; switching into another college requires checking its rules.

ap.text: Current credit examples: AP Statistics 3 earns STAT 1010 (4 credits); 4–5 earns STAT 2010 (4 credits). AP Psychology 4–5 earns PSYCH 1010 (3 credits). These are credit awards, not admission cutoffs; recheck the catalog for 2028.

cost.text: 2026–27 international base tuition $31,962 USD and fees $1,586. The on-campus dependent budget totals $50,960 when published housing, books, personal and travel components are added; required medical insurance is excluded. Major-specific tuition may be higher. 2028–29 costs: Not yet published.
cost.status: 2026–2027 reference; total calculated from official components

aid.text: Competitive international merit awards require OneApp and review grades/SAT/ACT. Federal and institutional loans are unavailable to international students. Need-based aid and CSS Profile requirement were not established by this review; confirm with the aid office. Citizenship affects eligibility.
